issues.description: React hydration error: Text content does not match server-rendered HTML. Multiple hydration mismatches causing entire root to switch to client rendering.
issues.element: Dashboard page - likely the greeting text with time-of-day ('Good evening') or the date ('Thursday, April 16') which are dynamic values computed differently on server vs client
issues.root_cause: The greeting text ('Good evening, Amelia.') and/or the date string ('Thursday, April 16') are being generated using Date() or new Date() directly in the component body or during render without being wrapped in a useEffect or suppressing hydration. Server renders at one time, client renders at another, causing mismatch. Also possibly the stats values are dynamically computed.

issues.description: Style Profile radar chart is missing from the dashboard - expected per the spec but not visible in the screenshot
issues.element: Style Profile section with radar chart
issues.root_cause: The Style Profile radar chart section may not be rendered on the dashboard page, or it may be below the fold / not implemented in the dashboard page component.

issues.description: Third room card 'Dining Room Curation' tag is cut off showing 'NATU...' instead of full tag name
issues.root_cause: CSS overflow/truncation on the tag container for the third card when it is partially visible at the right edge of the viewport.
